Title: Verify login with valid credentials
Test Steps: 1. Open Log In page. 2. Enter valid email and password. 3. Click Log In.
Expected Result: User is logged in and lands on the home/search page.

Title: Verify login fails with an incorrect password
Test Steps: 1. Enter valid email. 2. Enter wrong password. 3. Click Log In.
Expected Result: Error message shown; user stays on Log In page; password is not revealed.

Title: Verify login fails with an unregistered email
Test Steps: 1. Enter an unregistered email. 2. Enter any password. 3. Click Log In.
Expected Result: Clear error message; login blocked.

Title: Verify login with empty fields
Test Steps: 1. Leave email and password empty. 2. Click Log In.
Expected Result: Mandatory-field messages shown; no login.

Title: Verify password field masks the input
Test Steps: 1. Type a password in the Password field.
Expected Result: Characters are masked and not readable.

Title: Verify sign up with valid details
Test Steps: 1. Open Sign Up. 2. Enter valid name, email, password. 3. Submit.
Expected Result: Account created; success message or redirect.

Title: Verify sign up with an already registered email
Test Steps: 1. Open Sign Up. 2. Enter the registered email and other valid data. 3. Submit.
Expected Result: Error that the email exists; no duplicate account.

Title: Verify sign up with an invalid email format
Test Steps: 1. Open Sign Up. 2. Enter email: john.doe / john@ / john@@domain.com. 3. Submit.
Expected Result: Validation error; sign up blocked.

Title: Verify sign up with a weak or short password
Test Steps: 1. Enter valid details with a 3-character password. 2. Submit.
Expected Result: Password rules shown; sign up blocked.

Title: Verify sign up with empty mandatory fields
Test Steps: 1. Leave all fields empty. 2. Submit.
Expected Result: Each empty field shows a message; form not submitted.

Title: Verify booking a round-trip flight
Test Steps: 1. Choose Round Trip. 2. Enter origin, destination, departure and return dates. 3. Search. 4. Select outbound and return flights.
Expected Result: Both flights appear in the summary with correct dates.

Title: Verify flight search with multiple passengers
Test Steps: 1. Select 2 adults and 1 child. 2. Search.
Expected Result: Results shown; total fare is for 3 passengers.

Title: Verify fare calculation for multiple passengers
Test Steps: 1. Search for 3 passengers. 2. Note fare per passenger. 3. Compare with the total.
Expected Result: Total = per-passenger fare x passengers (+ taxes); currency formatted correctly.

Title: Verify sorting/filtering results by price
Test Steps: 1. Sort price low to high. 2. Sort high to low.
Expected Result: Order is correct in both directions. (Mark N/A if not available.)

Title: Verify booking on a leap day (29 Feb)
Test Steps: 1. Select 29 Feb of a leap year as departure. 2. Search.
Expected Result: Date is accepted; results shown.

Title: Verify Select Flight in Chrome, Firefox and Edge
Test Steps: 1. Open the Select Flight page in each browser. 2. Search and select a flight.
Expected Result: Layout and behaviour are the same in all three.

Title: Verify return date earlier than departure date is not allowed
Test Steps: 1. Choose Round Trip. 2. Return date earlier than departure date. 3. Search.
Expected Result: Error message; search blocked.

Title: Verify search when no flights are available
Test Steps: 1. Search a route/date with no flights.
Expected Result: Friendly 'no flights found' message; no crash or blank page.

Title: Verify search with empty origin or destination
Test Steps: 1. Leave origin or destination empty. 2. Search.
Expected Result: Mandatory-field message shown.

Title: Verify selecting more than the maximum passengers
Test Steps: 1. Increase passengers beyond the allowed limit.
Expected Result: Limit enforced with a clear message.

Title: Verify booking with 2+ passengers and valid details
Test Steps: 1. Enter valid details for passenger 1 and 2. 2. Click Next.
Expected Result: All passenger details saved and shown on summary.

Title: Verify maximum length of First/Last Name
Test Steps: 1. Enter 1 character. 2. Enter 50+ characters. 3. Click Next.
Expected Result: Limit enforced or data accepted within the stated range.

Title: Verify details retained when going back from payment
Test Steps: 1. Click Back. 2. View passenger page.
Expected Result: Previously entered data is still present.

Title: Verify Last Name rejects numeric characters
Test Steps: 1. Enter 1 in Last Name. 2. Enter valid First Name. 3. Click Next.
Expected Result: Error shown; user cannot proceed.
Actual Result: Numeric value in Last Name is accepted and user can proceed (per bug FSP-18).

Title: Verify First Name rejects numeric characters
Test Steps: 1. Enter 123 in First Name. 2. Enter valid Last Name. 3. Click Next.
Expected Result: Error shown; user cannot proceed.

Title: Verify names reject special characters
Test Steps: 1. Enter @#$% in First and Last Name. 2. Click Next.
Expected Result: Validation error shown.

Title: Verify email and phone reject invalid formats
Test Steps: 1. Enter invalid email and phone. 2. Click Next.
Expected Result: Validation errors for both. (N/A if fields are absent.)

Title: Verify leading/trailing spaces in names
Test Steps: 1. Enter ' John ' with spaces. 2. Click Next.
Expected Result: Spaces trimmed or rejected consistently.

Title: Verify payment with American Express
Test Steps: 1. Select Amex. 2. Enter valid card details. 3. Pay.
Expected Result: Payment succeeds; confirmation shown. (N/A if unsupported.)

Title: Verify payment amount equals total fare
Test Steps: 1. Note total fare. 2. Pay with a valid card. 3. Compare charged amount.
Expected Result: Charged amount equals total fare exactly.

Title: Verify payment with an expired card
Test Steps: 1. Enter valid number with a past expiry date. 2. Pay.
Expected Result: Error shown; payment blocked.

Title: Verify payment with an invalid expiry month
Test Steps: 1. Enter month 13 or 00. 2. Pay.
Expected Result: Validation error shown.

Title: Verify payment with an empty expiry date
Test Steps: 1. Leave expiry empty. 2. Pay.
Expected Result: Mandatory-field message shown.

Title: Verify payment with an empty CVV
Test Steps: 1. Leave CVV empty. 2. Pay.
Expected Result: Mandatory-field message shown.

Title: Verify payment with an incomplete CVV (2 digits)
Test Steps: 1. Enter 2-digit CVV. 2. Pay.
Expected Result: Validation error shown.

Title: Verify payment with letters in the CVV
Test Steps: 1. Enter 'abc' in CVV. 2. Pay.
Expected Result: Letters rejected.

Title: Verify card number longer than the maximum length
Test Steps: 1. Enter a 20-digit card number. 2. Pay.
Expected Result: Extra digits blocked or error shown.

Title: Verify card number is masked on confirmation page
Test Steps: 1. Complete payment. 2. View confirmation.
Expected Result: Only the last 4 digits are visible.

Title: Verify confirmation page after successful payment
Test Steps: 1. Complete a valid booking. 2. Pay with a valid card.
Expected Result: Confirmation shows booking reference, flight, passengers and amount.

Title: Verify user can return and book a new flight after payment
Test Steps: 1. Log in. 2. Book a flight with all data. 3. Pay. 4. Look for a way to go back or book again.
Expected Result: A button/link to book a new flight or return home is visible.
Actual Result: User is stuck on flight information page with no way back (per bug FSP-17).

Title: Verify back button after payment does not duplicate the booking
Test Steps: 1. Click the browser Back button after payment.
Expected Result: No second charge or duplicate booking.

Title: Verify confirmation details match the booking
Test Steps: 1. Compare confirmation with the selected flight and passengers.
Expected Result: Route, dates, passengers and fare are identical.

Title: Verify cancelling a booking before payment
Test Steps: 1. Click Cancel before paying.
Expected Result: Booking is not created; no charge.

Title: Verify session timeout during booking
Test Steps: 1. Stay idle until the session expires. 2. Continue.
Expected Result: User asked to log in again; no partial or duplicate booking.

Title: Verify selecting an available seat
Test Steps: 1. Select an available seat.
Expected Result: Seat reserved and shown in summary. (N/A if unavailable.)

Title: Verify selecting an already booked seat
Test Steps: 1. Try to select a booked seat.
Expected Result: Seat is not selectable. (N/A if unavailable.)
